title: MediaWiki REST API error response (v1, legacy)
description: Default error shape emitted by REST modules that don't opt in to errorSchemaVersion 2.0. Additional properties are allowed since handlers may attach extra data.

httpCode.description: The HTTP status code of the error response.

httpReason.description: The standard reason phrase of the HTTP status code, for example "Not Found".

message.description: A human-readable error message, useful when no message translations are available.
examples: The specified page does not exist

messageTranslations.description: A map of language codes to human-readable error messages, for clients that can use them.

examples.en: The specified page does not exist

errorKey.description: The message key identifying the error. Only present for localized errors.

reqId.description: The ID of the request. Only present for server errors; include it when reporting the error.

exception.description: Structured details of the exception that caused the error. Only present when the wiki is configured to show exception details.
